map.气象健康风险预警 使用指南: Weather Health Risk Alert User Guide
map.输入温度、湿度、风速、气压，计算各气象要素偏离舒适区的程度，加权得到综合健康风险: Enter the temperature, humidity, wind speed and air pressure to compute how far each weather element deviates from the comfort zone, and weight them into a composite health risk index and alert level.
map.对单灾种或多灾种叠加做风险分级。: Grade the risk for a single hazard or for overlapping hazards.
map.支撑应急预案与资源预置。: Supports emergency plans and resource pre-positioning.
map.跨区对比风险排优先级。: Compare risk across regions and prioritise.
map.：风险分 4 级：蓝(<40)/黄(40–60)/橙(60–80)/红(>80): There are four risk levels: blue (<40) / yellow (40-60) / orange (60-80) / red (>80); a composite score of 72 for a zone falls in orange, so the corresponding response must be started.
map.：暴雨(黄)+大风(橙)叠加 → 取高并按耦合升一级至红，因洪涝伴倒灌风险放大。: A rainstorm (yellow) plus strong wind (orange) overlapping → take the higher level and raise it one step to red on coupling, because the flood risk is amplified by backflow.
map.风险等级和预警色一致吗？: Are the risk level and the alert colour consistent?
map.通常一一对应（蓝黄橙红），但风险是「可能性×后果」、预警还含实时紧急度，略有差异: They usually correspond one to one (blue, yellow, orange, red), but risk is "likelihood × consequence" while the alert also includes real-time urgency, so there is a slight difference.
map.多灾叠加怎么评？: How do you assess overlapping hazards?
map.一般取最高级并视耦合效应上调，避免只看单灾低估复合灾害。: Generally take the highest level and raise it for coupling effects, so a single hazard does not lead to underestimating a compound hazard.
